Card Q&A.a: Yes, if a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself green, the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself green, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Effect: When you would play this card from your hand, if you have a green Digimon in play, reduce its play cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have a green Digimon in play, this Digimon gets +1000 DP for the turn.
